t: This is an extended version of the $(l:modules/sender_2)Sender Module Mk2/$, which can send items to multiple targets. $(thing)Sneak-right-click/$ an inventory to add it to the Distributor Module, and $(thing)Sneak-right-click/$ the inventory again to remove it.$(p)The Distributor Module can distribute to up to 8 targets.
这是 $(l:modules/sender_2)发送模块 Mk2/$ 的扩展版本，可以将物品发送到多个目标。$(thing)潜行右击/$一个容器以将其添加到分配模块中，再次对该容器执行 $(thing)潜行右击/$ 可将其移除。$(p)分配模块最多可以分配到 8 个目标。

A little extra control over distribution strategy is available via the GUI control on the right:$(li)$(bold)Round Robin/$ - distribute to each inventory in turn, as evenly as possible$(li)$(bold)Random/$ - pick one of the targets at random$(li)$(bold)Nearest/$ - always fill the closest target with space for the item$(li)$(bold)Furthest/$ - always fill the furthest target with space for the item
右侧的 GUI 控件还能提供一些额外的分配策略控制：$(li)$(bold)轮询/$ - 依次向各个容器分配，尽可能平均$(li)$(bold)随机/$ - 随机挑选一个目标$(li)$(bold)最近/$ - 总是优先填充最近且有空间容纳该物品的目标$(li)$(bold)最远/$ - 总是优先填充最远且有空间容纳该物品的目标
